name: Forward Vector
description:
About This Game

The demo contains the first level, a secret for the bravest players and the alpha in-game level editor.

Dive into Forward Vector, a relentless 3D auto-runner platformer in first-person view.

Sharpen your reflexes by performing flawless jumps, dives, and slides, and master aerial control to complete unforgiving levels set to intense electronic tracks.

If the old school difficulty of classic 2D auto-scroller is your thing, you'll be served, as Forward Vector brings the essentials of this genre with a new 3D first person perspective and more.

FEATURES

  • 12 tough but fairly design levels. And more levels are planned coming in future updates.

  • Satisfying first-person controls.

  • An advanced 3D level editor. To create and share levels with the community!

  • Collectibles and unlockable secrets!

  • Unique synchronized Intense electronics soundtracks! Bouncing your head throughout your runs.

  • Abstract futuristic environments.
short_desc: Push your limits in Forward Vector's 3D parkour! Perform flawless jumps and slides and master aerial control with satisfying first-person movement, on the beat of intense electronic tracks. No mistakes allowed, perfection is key. Can you achieve it?
